contract.intent: Reconcile the durable companion operating guide with the current thin, write-confined model: it must no longer claim a docs/ layer or that lock! records a docs/ placement, and its lock!/supersede! descriptions must match the confined signatures. The revised guide is produced as THIS task locked companion-guide artifact and supersedes the guide locked by 01-guide-kept (the AC-3 path of 01-guide-kept), so the durable operating contract reads current again.
acceptanceCriteria: A revised companion-guide.html is produced and locked under THIS task own artifacts/ (thin lock) and becomes current(companion-guide); supersede! advances it past the done producer 01-guide-kept, naming the successor by node id + the file basename (no raw path)

No surviving claim that lock! records a docs/ placement or that a docs/ layer is part of the current model — every docs/ mention in the guide is audited and reconciled to the thin model (real files under the node artifacts/, thin lock records)
The guide lock!/supersede! descriptions match the confined signatures in the command registry (ann commands output), not the retired free-<path> forms
ann check stays at the accepted baseline (no new findings) and the test suite stays green
The revision + supersede are evidenced under this task and the revised guide is committed
expectedOutputs: revised + locked companion-guide artifact (supersedes the 01-guide-kept version)
committed guide revision + this task events
